rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for the gemstone itself.

example.english: This string of pearl is beautiful; it will definitely stand out when worn.
example.traditional: 呢串珍珠好靚，戴出去一定好搶眼。
example.jyutping: ne1 cyun3 zan1 zyu1 hou2 leng3 daai3 ceot1 heoi3 jat1 ding6 hou2 coeng2 ngaan5

rows.note: Use this for a person or thing cherished as precious, rather than for the gemstone or a useful tip.

example.english: The old watch Mum left me is my pearl.
example.traditional: 阿媽留畀我嗰隻舊手錶係我嘅寶貝。
example.jyutping: aa3 maa1 lau4 bei2 ngo5 go2 zek3 gau6 sau2 biu1 hai6 ngo5 ge3 bou2 bui3

rows.note: Use this for a practical nugget of information, including a clinical pearl or useful tip.

example.english: The driving instructor gave me a pearl of parking advice: turning the wheel slowly makes it much easier.
example.traditional: 教車師傅畀咗我一個泊車貼士，話慢慢扭軚會容易好多。
example.jyutping: gaau3 ce1 si1 fu6 bei2 zo2 ngo5 jat1 go3 paak3 ce1 tip1 si2 waa6 maan6 maan6 nau2 taai5 wui5 jung4 ji6 hou2 do1
